verdict_reason: GROWTH-CONTOUR match of pyMack's c_i = 0.004 lobe to the digitized Özgen Fig. 3 lobes, by nearest-crossing in alpha at each digitized Re: M=2 median |Δα|/α = 15.7% (19/20 matched), M=4 median 26.5% (20/20 matched); overall median (pooled M2+M4 at c_i=0.004) = 18.8%. Secondary check — M=2 c_i = 0.012 lobe: NOT reproducible by pyMack (19/19 points had no crossing). pyMack's peak M=2 growth rate (c_i,max = 0.010906) is below 0.012, so the entire interior 0.012 lobe is ABSENT — pyMack under-predicts peak M=2 amplification. Topology: pyMack does NOT close the c_i = 0.004 lobe in the same (Re, alpha) region as the paper [M=2: OPEN — the c_i>0.004 region runs off the high-Re grid edge (does not descend back to small alpha); M=4: OPEN — the c_i>0.004 region runs off the high-Re grid edge (does not descend back to small alpha)]. The digitized lobe is a closed arch; pyMack's super-level set stays unstable out to the grid's Re_max, so topology_ok is False. Growth-vs-neutral context: the SEPARATELY-measured neutral curves (c_i = 0 contour) for these same Machs were classified 'disagrees' on open-lobe topology, with full-arch median rel-errs ~16% (M2) / ~17% (M4) and only the cutoff/apex sub-region matching to ~3-10%. The growth contours do NOT agree better overall: the c_i = 0.004 lobe matches at a comparable 15.7% for M=2 and a WORSE 26.5% for M=4 (pyMack's 0.004 contour is nearly flat in alpha rather than tracking the arch's descent), and the interior c_i = 0.012 lobe is entirely absent for M=2. The same open-lobe / under-amplification formulation discrepancy seen in the neutral curves persists in the growth-rate contours, so the verdict is 'disagrees', not 'agrees'.
pymack_provenance: c_i grid verification/neutralCurve_verification/_ozgen_compute/ozgen_combined_ci_grid.csv (24x30 mesh per Mach, log-spaced Re x linear alpha), from the Özgen Fig.3 overlay pipeline (solve_temporal_ozgen_2d, L* scale, TS/Mack-classified). For each digitized constant-c_i lobe point (Re*, alpha*) the c_i field is bilinearly interpolated (linear in log-Re between bracketing columns, linear in alpha) and pyMack's alpha on the c_i=LEVEL contour nearest alpha* is located; median |Δα|/α is the headline metric. Mirrors the neutral-curve engine (compare_ozgen_fig3.py) at c_i=LEVEL instead of c_i=0. Per-lobe pyMack contour artifacts: verification/growthRate_verification/ozgen_fig3_lobes/pymack_ozgen_M2_ci004.csv, verification/growthRate_verification/ozgen_fig3_lobes/pymack_ozgen_M2_ci012.csv, verification/growthRate_verification/ozgen_fig3_lobes/pymack_ozgen_M4_ci004.csv.
